items.title: Barry Kernfeld interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 16, 2020
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer conducting the session with Barry Kernfeld. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: Barry was interviewed via Zoom on December 16, 2020, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’m very happy to have Barry Kernfeld with me. And I’m going to introduce you, I’m not sure this would be the order of how you think of yourself, but a jazz historian, an author, an expert on song piracy, and a saxophonist. Does that work?
And an archivist these days. Yes.
